name: browser-use
headline: Moltbot Skills Library - AI Agent Skills
short_description: Moltbot Skills Library enables AI agents to perform tasks like crypto trading, DeFi operations, and automation. Operations teams benefit from pre-built skills and can contribute new ones via PRs. Integrates with Claude agents and supports Python.
author: BankrBot

sections.overview:
Moltbot Skills Library is a directory of reusable skills designed for AI agents including Claude Code and Cursor. It enables automation of cryptocurrency trading, DeFi operations, and other tasks through pre-built, composable modules. The library supports Python and integrates with Claude agents, allowing developers to leverage existing skills or contribute new ones via pull requests. Operations teams benefit from a growing catalog of battle-tested implementations that handle financial precision, security considerations like prompt injection defense, and proper credential management through API key integration.
Automating cryptocurrency trading workflows with AI agents
Executing DeFi operations programmatically
Building custom automation scripts with pre-built skill components
Operations teams managing recurring trading and financial tasks
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/BankrBot/moltbot-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Use the Moltbot Skills Library to automate [TASK] for [TEAM/PROJECT]. Select a skill like 'crypto-trading' or 'defi-operations' from the library. Configure the skill with [PARAMETERS] such as trading pairs, risk tolerance, or automation triggers. Deploy the skill via Python scripts or integrate it directly into a Claude agent. Monitor performance in real-time using [TOOLS].
```
Copy

```
The Moltbot Skills Library was deployed to automate DeFi operations for the 'Operations' team at 'Example Protocol'. The selected skill, 'defi-operations', was configured with the following parameters: trading pairs set to ETH/USDC and SOL/USDC, risk tolerance set to medium (allowing up to 25% leverage on stablecoins), and automation triggers enabled for rebalancing every 4 hours and yield optimization at 00:00 UTC daily. The skill was deployed via a Python script named 'defi_automation.py', which integrated directly into a Claude agent named 'DeFi-Bot'. Performance was monitored in real-time using the 'DeFi-Dashboard' tool, which displayed the following data: total locked value in the protocol at $12,500,000, with $5,000,000 allocated to ETH/USDC and SOL/USDC pairs, yield optimization triggered at 00:00 UTC, resulting in a 3.2% increase in APY, and rebalancing executed every 4 hours, maintaining a stable 5% slippage tolerance. The 'Operations' team received a notification via Slack, stating: 'DeFi operations have been automated successfully. Monitor performance in the DeFi-Dashboard.'
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
